gates.detail: Email/PDF checked: Family Room for three + Super Deluxe Room for two, room only, ₹4,004.70 incl GST. Hotel confirms rooms ready on arrival. Check-in 10:00; checkout 09:00.

gates.title: One snorkelling participant slot still blank
gates.detail: Direct booking page checked: four names saved, Diver 5 blank; booking still provisional. The remaining traveller has been sent the private form link. Await submission; no new payment or repeated group reminders.

gates.detail: On 13 Dec at ILE Bay, confirm the 14 Dec early scuba pickup; on 14 Dec, confirm the 15 Dec pre-dawn kayak pickup/return. On Neil arrival, arrange the 16 Dec snorkelling ride and reporting buffer. Final driver details may arrive the previous evening.

gates.title: On arrival: arrange local rides and ferry transfers
gates.detail: Arrange rides locally for five adults plus bags. First airport pickup is in the cab package. Arrange each early jetty ride the previous evening, especially 17 Dec 08:30 reporting; avoid duplicate charges for activity transfers already included. Ask Pibo on 17 Dec to store bags after 09:00 checkout on 18 Dec.

gates.title: 4 Dec 09:00 IST: scheduled Jail-show booking check
gates.detail: One reminder/check is scheduled for five adults on 11 Dec: prefer 17:50 Hindi, 18:50 English fallback. Check the official release window and reporting instructions, then complete the booking. Museum entry is separate; no tickets have been purchased.

gates.title: During the stay: settle remaining payments as due
gates.detail: Per traveller decision, handle balances at the hotel/operator when due, and check the final statement then. Recorded water-activity balances total ₹41,173; do not pay the advances twice. Reconcile Pibo’s ₹2,000 credit and Exotica’s actual charge at settlement, with no pre-trip reconciliation task.

14.status: Booked · 50 min underwater · morning finish provisional
14.tonight: Pack ferry bags before the early kayak. Confirm the 03:30 programme pickup/return and breakfast plan.
14.protect: Reserve the morning to about 10:00 provisionally. Ask Seahawks about recovery and the following morning’s kayaking; office pin is not the confirmed meeting point.

15.headline: 03:30 kayak · report for Makruzz at 12:30
15.status: Kayak/ferry booked · Exotica ~₹14k; fifth-adult fee to check at arrival

15.protect: Kayak finish ~05:00 is provisional. Protect recovery, checkout/storage and the two-hour ferry report. Go to sunset only if ready to leave by ~16:00; otherwise use 16 Dec. At Exotica check-in, check the fifth adult, extra bed and final charge; ₹3,000 is only a reserve.

17.protect: Skip Sitapur if it threatens breakfast, checkout or the ferry report. After arrival, choose one outing; Cellular Jail is a fallback only if missed on 11 Dec.

18.headline: Pibo checkout 09:00 · airport ride waits for flight verification

18.protect: Pack and settle before 09:00 checkout; arrange luggage storage until airport pickup. The 10:15–10:30 ride / 10:45–11:00 airport target applies only if the 13:05 flight is confirmed. No sightseeing today.

reminders.activation: General preparation and trip reminders remain inactive until preparation starts. The explicitly requested one-time Cellular Jail booking check is separately scheduled for 4 Dec at 09:00 IST.
reminders.audience: Team andaman group plus each member individually; verify the then-current group roster privately before sending.
reminders.noisePolicy: Only useful alerts. Bundle preparation tasks, avoid duplicate reminders, no alerts for optional sightseeing; notify again only for a material time/location change or unresolved essential action.

preparation.what: One combined documents, forms, balances, packing and transfer checklist; include the single itinerary link.
One final essentials check; omit tasks already completed.

trip.when: One next-day briefing in the evening
trip.what: Tomorrow’s first essential time, pickup/report pin, what to carry and what needs confirmation. Avoid separate alerts for each optional stop.

trip.when: Before an essential departure or reporting deadline
trip.what: One practical leave-now alert based on the confirmed pickup/route plus buffer. Suppress it when an arranged driver pickup already covers the same action.

reminders.channels: A static website cannot send scheduled WhatsApp notifications. Calendar/reminder alerts and any WhatsApp delivery must be configured and tested in the preparation phase; delivery is not active or guaranteed by this plan.
